lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; equivalent under the interview's gate. The reply gates box 9b on k1p.has_b9bc alone; the project asks k1p.has_b9bc only when box 9a shows an amount (k1p.has_b9bc_if_9a: the 9b and 9c amounts are parts of the box 9a net long-term gain, i1065sk1 p. 16, Box 9a/9b/9c). Triage: 520/534 agree; the 14 differences are 7 candidate-unknown and 7 project-unknown on partial records, none a value. The line's change this round (Dollars, a loss allowed, BUG-0911) is not disputed: the reply also passes box 9b through signed.

Ruling: representation; equivalent under the interview's gate, as for k1p.box9b_if_any: the reply drops the box 9a gate on k1p.has_b9bc (k1p.has_b9bc_if_9a). Triage: 520/534 agree; 7 candidate-unknown, 7 project-unknown on partial records, no value difference. Ruling: interface gap; the reply inverts the interface. k1p.screened is true by construction and carries the K-1's refusals (the refusal list of forms/2025/k1p.yaml, each `when:` a gate such as k1p.not_at_risk_if_loss); every person.k1p_* sum filters on it, so a refused K-1 refuses the return. The reply builds a predicate that is true when a refusal applies, the opposite of the label 'passed every screen', and omits the trader, tests 4/6/7 and former-passive refusals. Triage: 109/534 agree; 171 project-refuses, 71 project-unknown, 183 value (the inversion). Same reading as the first-round ruling of this line.
